stories.title: From idea to national institution in just seven months.
stories.caption: Athos helped build the Miller National Academy for Free Expression and Pluralism from seed funding to a full-scale national launch—culminating in an inaugural event featuring President George W. Bush as keynote speaker.
stories.alt: The University of Denver campus from above

stories.title: Creating a growing community of social venture funders and founders.
stories.caption: Launched by Athos and Principled Business in March 2026, Breakthrough Builders culminated its first year with an over-capacity gathering in Austin in October 2026, where actor Kelsey Grammer introduced “American Revelation”—one of the breakthrough projects the community is helping bring to life.
stories.alt: A speaker addressing a Breakthrough Builders gathering

stories.title: Cultivating a generation of visionary fundraising leaders.
stories.caption: In August 2026, Athos Academy brought together 18 of the country’s most talented fundraisers and leaders in Austin for its inaugural gathering—an intensive exploration of Athos’s distinctive approach to vision-based fundraising.
stories.alt: The Athos Academy cohort on the porch of Arena Hall in Austin

stories.title: Taking the Athos playbook to the mainstage.
stories.caption: Athos founders Pano Kanelos and Chad Thevenot presented their “Nine Rules for Building a Breakthrough Social Venture” from the mainstage at both the ARC Conference in London (June 2026) and FreedomFest in Las Vegas (July 2026)—sharing the lessons behind building bold new institutions and movements.
stories.alt: Chad and Pano presenting “Building what comes next” on the mainstage
stories.alt2: Chad and Pano presenting Rule #9: Borrow credibility until you earn it

stories.title: Opening the door to a new era of higher education.
stories.caption: In May 2026, Athos launched the Global Accreditation Project (GAP)—an ambitious effort to build a new, outcomes-based accreditor designed to break down barriers to innovation, increase competition, and make it easier for bold new models of higher education to emerge.
stories.alt: The Global Accreditation Project introduced on the Cornerstone Talks stage

partners.name: Dr. Pano Kanelos

team.name: Meg Court

team.name: Lindsey Lawrence

team.name: Asra Nadeem
team.bio: CEO of DraperU and Partner at DraperU Ventures investing in frontier tech — AI, aerospace, defense. Led investments in 57+ companies including three unicorns.

team.bio: 30+ years in independent higher education across faculty, provost, and consultant roles. Extensive accreditation experience including authoring reports and serving agencies.

about.mission: The Athos Group serves those who believe that ideas have consequences — and that the right institutions, built well, can change the course of history. We bring strategy, relationships, and execution to help founders and funders build and scale institutions that matter.

principles.title: Courageous visions and strategies
principles.text: We champion innovation, differentiation, and outsized impact. The institutions that endure are those bold enough to pursue a vision others haven't yet imagined.

principles.title: Bottom-up approaches
principles.text: We develop authentic, engaged communities of learners, educators, and supporters. Lasting institutions are built from within — not imposed from above.

principles.title: Intellectual pluralism and freedom of inquiry
principles.text: We hold intellectual pluralism and freedom of inquiry as core pillars of learning and discovery. A flourishing society depends on the uninhibited pursuit of truth.

principles.title: Radical transparency, accountability, and independence
principles.text: We operate with radical transparency, accountability, and independence to ensure institutional integrity. Trust is earned through honest counsel and consistent action.

principles.title: Institutional heterogeneity
principles.text: We believe in institutional heterogeneity — organizations designed to serve the unique needs of diverse audiences. One size does not fit all. Excellence demands distinction.

intro: At Athos, we build bold social ventures, and partner with the founders and funders who make them possible.
We work alongside visionary leaders to turn ambitious ideas into new institutions, and promising institutions into breakthrough organizations.
We bring the strategy, talent, relationships, and philanthropic capital needed to move from vision to velocity—fast.
We build new institutions that matter. We scale institutions that matter. And we connect funders with the institutions that matter.

areas.title: Turning bold ideas into new institutions
areas.context: Launching a new institution is extraordinarily hard. Even if the vision is clear, the path from idea to reality rarely is. Finding experienced people you can trust to build alongside you is even harder. Athos brings the strategy, relationships, and execution to move your idea from idea to launch.
items: Vision & Strategy
Sharpen the idea, test the opportunity, understand the landscape, and build a clear roadmap from concept to launch.
Institutional Design
Build the governance, organizational model, programs, budgets, regulatory pathways, and operating structures your institution needs to succeed.
Capital & Community
Develop the case for support, identify and cultivate founding funders, and build the community of allies, partners, and champions around your venture.
Leadership & Execution
Embed experienced builders to drive critical workstreams, recruit founding leadership, and create the early wins that create momentum, energy, and excitement.
Narrative & Launch
Create the positioning, messaging, brand, communications, events, and launch strategy that introduce your institution to the world.

areas.title: Helping promising institutions break through
areas.context: Many organizations reach a point where what got them here won't get them where they need to go next. The opportunity is bigger than the institution's current strategy, team, fundraising capacity, or infrastructure. Athos works alongside organizational leaders to break through those constraints and accelerate the next stage of growth.
items: Strategy for Scale
Clarify where the institution can have outsized impact, sharpen its differentiation, and translate ambition into an actionable growth strategy.
Fundraising & Growth
Strengthen the case for support, identify and cultivate major donors, build development systems, and add senior fundraising capacity when needed.
Leadership & Capacity
Provide fractional senior leadership, recruit critical executives, and strengthen the organizational capabilities required for the next stage.
Narrative & Reach
Sharpen the institution's story, positioning, communications, partnerships, and events to expand its influence and community.
Execution & Acceleration
Put experienced operators alongside your team to drive priority initiatives and turn strategy into measurable progress.

areas.title: Connecting funders to the right institutions
areas.context: The hardest philanthropic question isn't simply how much to give, but where your capital can make a breakthrough difference. The most consequential opportunities are often emerging, difficult to evaluate, or don't exist yet. Athos gives funders access to the people, ideas, and institutions shaping what comes next.
items: Find What Matters
Identify high-potential founders, emerging institutions, and overlooked opportunities aligned with your philanthropic vision.
Know What Works
Provide independent diligence on leadership, strategy, governance, financial sustainability, and potential for real impact.
Build What's Missing
When the institution that should exist doesn't yet, help conceive, design, launch, and capitalize it.
Strengthen What You Back
Work alongside promising grantees to address strategic, leadership, fundraising, governance, or execution challenges that could limit their impact.
Build the Network
Connect funders with exceptional founders, fellow philanthropists, scholars, and leaders through curated introductions, gatherings, and communities.

items.title: Global Accreditation Project (GAP) Takes Shape in Bid to Bring Personalization and Common Sense to Higher Ed Accreditation
items.text: The Global Accreditation Project is building a new kind of accreditor: one that shifts higher education from compliance to outcomes, conformity to pluralism, and bureaucracy to real quality assurance. Targeting a full launch by summer 2028.

items.title: Athos and Principled Business Introduce Breakthrough Builders to Fast-Track Funding for Early-Stage Social Ventures
items.text: Breakthrough Builders is a new community of founders, philanthropists, and advisors committed to launching and funding the most promising early-stage social ventures.

items.title: The Athos Group Launches to Help Founders and Funders Build the Institutions of Tomorrow
items.text: The renewal of society depends on the renewal of its institutions. Athos partners with visionaries to provide strategic vision, fundraising, and storytelling: taking institutions from 0 to 1 and 1 to 10.
